sentences.text: This is second bail application filed by applicant-Israj alias Ish Khan in Case Crime No. 355 of 2020, under Sections 376 IPC and 3/4, 7/8 POCSO Act, Police Station New Agra, District Agra.
3. First bail application of applicant was rejected by reasoned order dated 18.03.2021 and relevant part thereof is reproduced hereinafter:

?Having heard learned counsel for both sides and gone through materials on record,
it is apparent that the first information report was got lodged by informant with this Israj @ Ish Khan vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52485596/
1 specific mention that prosecutrix was under trauma and shock, when asked after developing confidence, she narrated this sexual assault committed by her tutor- present applicant.

sentences.text: Then after this offence under Section 354-Kha IPC read with Section 7/8 of POCSO Act was got registered and when statement under Section 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., was got recorded, prosecutrix reiterated contention of commission of rape by her, who happens to be her tutor.
She has been held to be of 14 years of age in medical age determination by the Medical Board.

Considering the heinousness of offence of rape with a tiny girl of 14 years of age by her tutor,, general prevalence of atrocities towards feminine, likelihood of tampering the evidence and the likelihood of fleeing from course of justice, it is not proper to grant of bail to accused applicant.?
4.
Applicant before this Court is facing trial for offence of rape of a minor girl and he is in jail since 27.08.2020.
5. Learned counsel for applicant submits that charges were framed on 05.08.2023, however, till date not a single witness has been examined.
Learned counsel is not able to deny that victim, a girl, aged about 13 years, has made specific allegation against applicant in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
She further submits that no photographs or video was recovered.
Learned counsel further submits that initially FIR was lodged for outrage of modesty however later on story of rape of minor girl was introduced.
6. Learned AGA has opposed the above submissions and referred that statement of victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and medical report.

7. I have considered the above mentioned rival submissions in referred factual and legal backgrounds and in view of established principle of jurisprudence of bail i.e ?bail is rule and jail is exception? as well as relevant factors for consideration of a bail application such as (i) whether there is any prima facie or reasonable ground to believe that the accused had committed the offence; (ii)
nature and gravity of the accusation (iii) severity of the punishment in the event of conviction; (iv)
danger of the accused absconding or fleeing, if released on bail; (v) character, behaviour, means,
position and standing of the accused;(vi) likelihood of the offence being repeated; (vii) reasonable apprehension of the witnesses being influenced; (viii) danger, of course of justice being thwarted by grant of bail etc, and that an order to grant or not to grant bail must assigned reasons (see Deepak Yadav vs State of U.P. (2022) 8 SCC 559, Manoj Kumar Khokar vs State of Rajasthan and Anr (2022) 3 SCC 501, The State of Jharkhand vs Dhananjay Gupta @ Dhananjay Prasad Gupta: Order dated 7.11.2023 in SLP(Crl) No.10810/2023, Shiv Kumar Vs The State of U.P. and Ors : Order dated 12.9.2023 in Criminal Appeal No.2782 of 2023), I am of considered opinion that present is not a fit case to grant bail to applicant mainly on following grounds:-
(a) Applicant is facing trial for serious offence of committing rape of a minor girl and the allegation is corroborated by statement of victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.

however, despite summons no witness has come forward to depose.

8. However, considering the nature of allegation, this application is disposed of with a direction to Trial Court concerned to take all endeavour to record statement of victim within a period of three months from today and thereafter applicant will have liberty to approach this Court of Trial Court concerned, as advised, alongwith status of trial and statement of victim.
